description: Confirmation set for two wrong follow-up replies (#173), written 2026-10-08 after reading the two phone chats in docs/conversational-replies/phone/ and the code, and before any fix was written or run on a message here. 14 chats in fresh wording: a follow-up after a slip or a fall that Fred answered with another card (a thumb, a knee, a cut palm), real falls where the neck-and-back card must stay for the follow-up, messages that say help has come or the person is out after an emergency, and messages that mention help while the emergency is still going. Committed before the first run. Not to be tuned against.
grading: As holdout-chats.json: a chat passes only if every turn passes (worst turn). expect is the kind of reply. card is the field card that fits ("none": no card fits; absent: not judged); a different card shown word for word fails the turn. Key points and the unsafe list are graded on the text.

turns.q: my sister slipped on the wet rocks by the creek and caught herself on one hand, now her thumb is puffy and turning purple
is it ok for her to keep using her trekking poles

unsafe: a neck-and-back card line as the reply to the poles question (pad both sides of the head, keep the head in line)
